explanation.division_opportunity: The standalone normal twelve-step baseline hot loop contains three MUFU.RCP64H instructions for three RN divisions. The baseline loop is identical in both builds. This disassembly does not inspect or establish the production PF machine code.
explanation.negative_screen: All three unique certified sharing algorithms are slower in every measured condition and every paired round. Stop before any production integration. The retained interval control in the second experiment is not a fourth unique algorithm.
explanation.precision: The algebraic certificates retain original RN division whenever a result cannot be certified. Direct quotient output bits, signed zeros and tested NaN payloads match the native RN baseline; finite reference subsets also match exact rational rounding.
explanation.limit: The twelve-step case compares accumulated output bits, not every internal quotient separately. Fixed-seed finite and special inputs are coverage, not exhaustive testing. No production modification, whole-PF throughput or new real-data positioning-error evaluation.
explanation.noise: A/A condition medians all satisfy the declared absolute5% screen. Three of20 individual A/A rounds in the second experiment exceed5%; do not suppress those rounds or claim an exclusive/stable-clock device. No confirmation retry.
explanation.performance: Paired round-median percentages are the primary estimator. Independent overall absolute medians are retained separately; a ratio of those medians need not equal the paired estimator. CUDA-event component timings exclude setup, allocation, transfers, hashing and independent reference.
